facts.text: Internal administrators and delegated administrators can restore environments; must have D365 BACKUP/RESTORE permission set assigned.
Restore requires paid Business Central subscription; maximum 10 restores per calendar month per environment.
Environments restore to within 28 days of current date; restores must stay in same Azure region and localization as original.
Production environments restore to production or sandbox; sandbox environments restore only to sandbox type.
Restored environment uses the major/minor version from restore point; cannot restore to version in grace or enforced update period.
Development extensions from Visual Studio Code are unavailable in restored sandbox; Marketplace apps receive latest available hotfix automatically.
Select Environments, open environment, select Restore, specify date/time, choose environment type, enter name, then select Restore.
Newly created environments require up to 30 minutes before backups initialize; backup issues can prevent restore.
